exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Verb + ところ".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb る ところ matches "Verb + ところ".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb る ところ.
exercises.explanation: Expresses being just about to do an action; "about to [verb]".
